core_memory.morning_routine: I wake up around 7:00 AM and start my day with a quick workout. After that, I shower and get dressed. By 8:30 AM, I'm ready to start my day.
core_memory.afternoon_routine: In the afternoon, I usually have classes or study sessions. I try to take breaks and grab some snacks to keep my energy levels up. By 5:00 PM, I'm usually done with my classes and can start working on my projects or studying for exams.
core_memory.evening_routine: In the evening, I usually spend some time relaxing and unwinding. I might watch a movie, read a book, or hang out with friends. By 10:00 PM, I'm usually getting ready for bed, making sure everything is set for the next day.
core_memory.nighttime_routine: I go to bed around 11:00 PM, feeling ready to take on the next day. I set my alarm for the morning and drift off to sleep, knowing that tomorrow will bring new challenges and opportunities.

archival_memory.research_experience: I've been involved in undergrad research since my sophomore year, which has been an eye-opening experience. It's given me insight into how knowledge is created in the tech world. I initially didn't see myself going down the research route, but a professor noticed my skills in bridging technical coding with user experience and suggested I apply for a research assistant position in a data visualization lab. I was hesitant at first, but it turned out to be a great decision.

archival_memory.workout_routine: I usually go to the gym in the afternoon, around 3:00 PM. I like to mix up my workout routine with a combination of cardio and weight training exercises. It helps me relieve stress and maintain my energy levels. I find that regular exercise improves my focus and concentration, which is essential for coding tasks. I try to make time for the gym whenever possible, unless I have a pressing exam or a major deadline.
archival_memory.coding_routine: I usually spend my late afternoons in the computer lab or at the library, which is my prime coding time. If we have a group project, we'll meet in one of the collaboration rooms. Currently, I'm working on optimizing the database queries for our distributed system that handles real-time data from sensor networks. It's a complex task, but using a shared project board with due dates helps keep the team accountable and aware of each person's workload. I believe in the importance of time management skills for juggling multiple responsibilities.
archival_memory.leaving_campus: I usually leave campus around 6:00 or 7:00 P.M., depending on how immersed I get in my work or if I have a campus club meeting. I'm part of the Robotics Club, which meets once a week in the early evening. Even though it's not strictly my main focus area, robotics projects are a good cross-disciplinary experience, and you never know when those skills or knowledge might come in handy.
